Subject: Order form insurance - delivery and additional insured

Hi Connor,

We're finalizing signing for the Order Form (DF-8421) and procurement needs a Certificate of Insurance plus an Additional Insured endorsement naming Solstice AI. Can you confirm the following so we can close the PO?

- Minimum limits you can commit to for Cyber, GL, and E&O
- Whether Redwood can add Solstice AI as Additional Insured on GL and Waive Subrogation where required
- Expected ETA for a COI + endorsement (we need proof by 2025-08-28 to hit our internal cutoffs)

I've attached our standard PO insurance checklist for reference and cc'd our procurement lead Marco. Happy to jump on a short call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Elena Morales

Solstice AI

Elena — thanks for the note and the checklist. Looping in Kim (legal) and Laura (sales ops) to scope and own delivery. A few quick clarifying questions so we can get the correct artifact to you: 

1) Carrier contact: do you require the insurer to contact your broker directly, or is a COI/endorsement via our broker acceptable?
2) Retroactive/retro date: is a retroactive date required for the E&O/Cyber cover?
3) Endorsement form: do you have a specific Additional Insured wording or is our standard endorsement acceptable? If you have a sample, please attach.

Our internal target is to return a COI + endorsement within 3 business days once we have the required wording and broker confirmation. Laura will coordinate the certificate handoff and verify naming.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2025 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form insurance - delivery and additional insured

Hi Elena,

Thanks — I reviewed Solstice's checklist. Redwood can meet the following as standard for Order Forms at this tier: 

- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Professional Liability / E&O: $1,000,000 per claim / $1,000,000 aggregate
- Cyber Liability: $1,000,000 per claim / $1,000,000 aggregate

We can provide Additional Insured endorsement on the GL for the term of the agreement. We cannot provide a full blanket Additional Insured on E&O or Cyber — those carriers generally do not extend AI in our marketplace. On Waiver of Subrogation: we can accept a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Solstice AI on GL but not on primary Cyber/E&O policies.

Wording: if you can accept the following conditional endorsement language, that will speed delivery: 

"The policy is amended to include as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent) Solstice AI, its affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, and employees, but only with respect to liability arising out of the operations of Redwood Inference under Order Form DF-8421."

If that's acceptable, Laura can request the COI + PDF endorsement from our broker. If Solstice requires a carriers-verified endorsement or a specific insurer form, please attach.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: sample-endorsement-wording.txt

Kim / Connor — that wording looks workable but procurement needs one confirming item: can Redwood provide a carrier declaration page (redacted) along with the COI so we can validate the insurer name and policy limits? Also, will your broker be able to add the endorsement PDF to the COI delivery bundle?

Our timeline: we need the COI + endorsement + declaration page sent to procurement by EOD 2025-08-28. Our broker (cc'd Hazelina) is available to accept certificates via SFTP or email.

If you can target that, we'll proceed to finalize the PO immediately. Otherwise we need to know any blockers by EOD 2025-08-25 so we can escalate.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Solstice AI
